title: A Momento Creatonis

source_provenance.copyright_status: user-supplied; source text is not copied into this fixture

corpus_summary: Gabriel rescues Clarion as a child, entrusts her with an amphora containing part of his Grace, and promises to return.
Decades later Gabriel returns after death and cosmic dispersal, while Clarion has become a Prophet suffering apocalyptic visions.
Clarion proposes that long exposure to Gabriel's Grace has changed her soul and that Gabriel can complete her transformation into a seventh Archangel.
The transformation produces Sariel, who restores Gabriel and recharges Heaven, but Gabriel is left dangerously depleted.
Sariel stabilises their shared energy by weaving a bond through Spirit, fire, earth, water, and air; the amphora later refills with their shared Grace.
Chuck identifies their connection as a rare Mate bond and warns that a previous pair suffered catastrophic bond failure during battle.
The prior surviving Archangel became fragmented after the bond was severed and was confined to Purgatory; Sariel links that history to the Dark Host and the current apocalypse.
Chuck reveals that this universe was one of many neglected creations and that he will soon be gone, leaving Gabriel and Sariel to determine the universe's ending themselves.
